{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 0.50

|gr1= Unit Inventory

|descr= Returns the percentage of fullness of a unit's cargo. Output is usually in range 0..1, but can be higher after using certain scripting commands (like [[addWeaponWithAttachmentsCargoGlobal]]) which ignore load values when adding items.
{{Feature|informative|See {{Link|#Example 2}} for load calculation.}}

|s1= [[load]] unit

|p1= unit: [[Object]] - (before {{GVI|arma3|2.08|size= 0.75}} the command did not support containers, ammo boxes, weapon holders, vehicle cargos)

|r1= [[Number]]

|x1= <sqf>load player;</sqf>

|x2= unit load calculation formula:
<sqf>private _unitLoad = loadAbs _unit / getNumber (configFile >> "CfgInventoryGlobalVariable" >> "maxSoldierLoad");</sqf>

|seealso= [[maxLoad]] [[loadAbs]] [[loadBackpack]] [[loadUniform]] [[loadVest]] [[getMass]] [[weightRTD]] [[getContainerMaxLoad]]
}}
